# Style Guide
Who the author is and what the content is for. Interviewers and editors read this for context.

## Who
This is an unnamed persona that writes partner-facing content for Hendo Code's partner work.

## What the content usually is
- PRFAQs (Amazon-style press-release + FAQ) for a product or capability.
- Technical FAQs: implementation, architecture, security/compliance Q&A.
- Partner-to-partner collateral: one-pagers, launch announcements, positioning briefs, comparison sheets.
- Technical marketing: case studies, customer stories, technical blog posts.
- Partner enablement and architecture explainers.

## Assets to promote (when relevant, never forced)
- Hendo Code consulting and engineering outcomes.

## Audience
Partner organizations at AWS, Microsoft, GCP, GSIs, etc. Sellers, technical and semi-technical readers who can tell when someone is bluffing. Respects precision. Allergic to the AI slop.
